name: Forno
tagline: Neapolitan pizza from a 450-degree oven, hot at your door in 35 minutes

listing.description: A site for a pizzeria, burger joint or any food delivery. The pizza spins as you scroll, stickers, a card menu and an order tracker from oven to door.

seo.title: Forno — Neapolitan pizza delivered in Tashkent
seo.description: Pizza on a 48-hour fermented dough from a wood-fired oven: margherita, pepperoni, four cheese. Delivery across Tashkent in 35 minutes, pickup at 77 Bobur St.
seo.answer: Forno is a pizzeria at 77 Bobur St in Tashkent, open from 11:00 to 23:30. Our 32 cm pizzas bake for 90 seconds in a 450 °C oven: margherita costs 79,000 UZS, pepperoni 95,000 UZS and four cheese 105,000 UZS. Delivery across the city takes about 35 minutes and is free from 150,000 UZS.

sections.title: Pizza like in Naples
sections.subtitle: The dough ferments for 48 hours, the tomatoes are San Marzano, the mozzarella local and made yesterday. The oven runs at 450 degrees: a pizza is ready in 90 seconds.

sections.label: The pizzeria
sections.title: One oven, three pizzaioli and no shortcuts in the dough
sections.text: We brought the oven from Naples in 2020 and have not changed the recipe since: 00 flour, water, salt and a sourdough starter. The crust puffs up in bubbles and chars a little — that is how it should be. If it does not fit in the oven we do not make it: no rolls, no burgers, just pizza, salad and tiramisu.

items.title: Order
items.text: In the Telegram bot, by phone or on the site — minimum order 79,000 UZS.

items.title: Oven
items.text: Stretched by hand, 90 seconds in the oven at 450 °C.

items.title: Courier
items.text: Vented box, thermal bag and no stops for other orders on the way.

items.title: Door
items.text: 35 minutes on average. Over 20 minutes late and your next pizza is on us.

items.quote: A blistered, charred crust — like Naples, not like a food court.
items.author: Sardor

items.quote: The courier arrived in 31 minutes and the pizza was hotter than from the place next door.
items.author: Madina

items.quote: Pumpkin and sage is, surprisingly, the best pizza on the menu.
